items.title: Deebo Samuel: Slated for MRI
items.text:
Samuel is scheduled to undergo an MRI after exiting Sunday's 32-29 win over the Seahawks due to a hamstring injury, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Roman Wilson: Expected to miss time
items.text:
Wilson is expected to miss a couple of weeks after exiting Sunday's 34-22 win over the Colts due to a finger injury, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kyle Pitts: Scores first TD of season
items.text:
Pitts caught five of six targets for 42 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 30-23 overtime loss to the Ravens.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Mark Andrews: Costly fumble in OT win
items.text:
Andrews caught four of six targets for 28 yards and lost a fumble in Sunday's 30-23 overtime win over the Falcons.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tua Tagovailoa: Picked off in OT after Penix injury
items.text:
Tagovailoa completed two of three passes for 34 yards and an interception in relief of Michael Penix (ribs) in Sunday's 30-23 overtime loss to the Ravens.
